bias_notes: Current enriched sample is complaint-heavy and dominated by Play Store reviews.
Discovery-specific themes should be interpreted alongside this source bias.

opportunities.title: Rebuild trust before cross-sell
opportunities.user_problem: Family Household users do not want to try more categories when core grocery or delivery experiences feel unreliable.
opportunities.opportunity_statement: Improve quality, refund, and service confidence before pushing category expansion.
recommended_moves: Surface freshness or replacement guarantees near adjacent-category modules.
Show delivery reliability and issue-resolution reassurance before trial prompts.
Target category expansion prompts only after a clean recent order history.
opportunities.expected_business_effect: Higher trust should reduce drop-off from expansion prompts and increase willingness to try adjacent categories.
assumptions_and_unknowns: Reliability concerns are suppressing exploration, not just driving churn.
Trust cues placed near expansion surfaces will change willingness to browse or add items.
The current sample is still dominated by Play Store complaints and should be treated as directional.
No recommendation here should be treated as proof of causality without an experiment.

opportunities.title: Lower the first-try price risk
opportunities.user_problem: Habitual Replenisher users hesitate to add new-category items because total cost feels uncertain or not worth the risk.
opportunities.opportunity_statement: Reduce trial friction with clearer value communication and low-risk entry offers.
recommended_moves: Bundle adjacent-category trials with staple reorder journeys.
Use entry-price callouts and fee transparency before checkout.
Test limited-scope offers on categories with high hesitation and medium interest.
opportunities.expected_business_effect: Lower perceived risk should improve trial conversion in categories users already consider but do not purchase.
assumptions_and_unknowns: Users already have some intent but stop because economics are unclear.
Targeted offers will drive exploration without fully training users to wait for discounts.
The current sample is still dominated by Play Store complaints and should be treated as directional.
No recommendation here should be treated as proof of causality without an experiment.

opportunities.title: Make adjacent categories easier to notice
opportunities.user_problem: Family Household users stay in narrow replenishment missions because the app does not make new categories easy to find.
opportunities.opportunity_statement: Improve search, category browsing, and recommendation surfaces to reveal grocery and nearby categories.
recommended_moves: Add adjacent-category prompts during reorder and search journeys.
Improve homepage and category landing-page navigation for common missions.
Use contextual recommendations tied to basket contents instead of generic banners.
opportunities.expected_business_effect: Better discovery should increase browse depth and new-category consideration without needing deep discounts.
assumptions_and_unknowns: Users are willing to explore if relevant options are made visible at the right moment.
Discovery friction is a bigger constraint than supply for these themes.
The current sample is still dominated by Play Store complaints and should be treated as directional.
No recommendation here should be treated as proof of causality without an experiment.
